steps.name: Build bdock twice and compare
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$COMMIT" || { echo "checkout is not the verified commit $COMMIT" >&2; exit 1; }
# scripts/release.sh is the single archive builder; output stays outside the checkout.
TARGETS="$OS/$ARCH" RELEASE_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/first" sh scripts/release.sh
# A second build with an empty build cache must give the same bytes.
GOCACHE="$RUNNER_TEMP/gocache-second" TARGETS="$OS/$ARCH" RELEASE_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/second" sh scripts/release.sh
diff -r "$RUNNER_TEMP/first" "$RUNNER_TEMP/second"
grep -Fx "source_revision=$COMMIT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/first/PROVENANCE"
grep -Fx "source_modified=false" "$RUNNER_TEMP/first/PROVENANCE"
mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist"
name="bdock_${VERSION}_${OS}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/first/$name" "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist/$name"
(cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist" && sha256sum "$name" > "$name.sha256")

steps.name: Create the release
Smoke-test the shipped archive natively
Resolve the version and the run kind
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = push ] && [ "$REF_TYPE" = tag ]; then
  version=$(sh .github/scripts/release-verify.sh tag-version "$REF_NAME")
  tag=$REF_NAME
  dry_run=false
else
  version=$INPUT_VERSION
  sh .github/scripts/release-verify.sh dryversion "$version"
  tag=
  dry_run=true
fi
{
  echo "version=$version"
  echo "tag=$tag"
  echo "dry_run=$dry_run"
  echo "commit=$GITHUB_SHA"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Require the repository owner to have started the run
Require an annotated tag on a commit of main
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Fetch the tag object itself so a lightweight tag is not mistaken for an annotated one.
git fetch --force --no-tags "https://github.com/$REPO" "+refs/tags/$TAG:refs/tags/$TAG"
git fetch --force --no-tags "https://github.com/$REPO" '+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main'
commit=$(sh .github/scripts/release-verify.sh tag "$TAG" refs/remotes/origin/main)
test "$commit" = "$GITHUB_SHA" || { echo "tag $TAG names $commit but the run is for $GITHUB_SHA" >&2; exit 1; }

steps.name: Require a green CI run for the tagged commit
Require that no release exists for the tag
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if out=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/releases/tags/$TAG" 2>&1); then
  echo "a release for $TAG already exists" >&2
  exit 1
fi
case "$out" in
  *"HTTP 404"*) echo "no release for $TAG yet" ;;
  *) echo "cannot tell whether a release exists: $out" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

steps.name: Require a version above every existing release
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Tags (annotated ones peeled) and releases, so a deleted tag with a surviving release counts too.
tags=$(git ls-remote --tags "https://github.com/$REPO" 'refs/tags/bdock/v*' | cut -f2 | sed 's|^refs/tags/||; s|\^{}$||')
releases=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/releases" --paginate --jq '.[].tag_name')
printf '%s\n%s\n' "$tags" "$releases" | sh .github/scripts/release-verify.sh monotonic "$TAG"

version.description: Dry-run version label (a dispatch never publishes)
